ModMetaData.name: RimOPT
ModMetaData.author: Allen
ModMetaData.description: RimOPT 1.7 pulse-analysis alpha: opt-in frame/tick/job-work time histograms for stutter investigation, plus conservative and independently switchable candidate pruning. No asynchronous job deferral, scheduler replacement, or TickManager behavior change. RimWorld 1.6 work-search behavior remains in its original DLL.
